# Lionel Fairlie & Wilson

- [Lionel Fairlie](../character/lionel-fairlie.md) — Commands — [Wilson](../character/wilson.md) — master of house · since v5  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P27](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0027), [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P61](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0061)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Grace](../character/grace.md) walks through the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) with [Edmund Carrow](../character/edmund-carrow.md), enduring an insult from [Dan Coyle](../character/coyle.md) on her way to visit [Lionel Fairlie](../character/lionel-fairlie.md). When she arrives at Lionel's residence, he berates and dismisses her request for him to return to church. Furious at his treatment, [Grace](../character/grace.md) marches back into his house to confront him.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT

TIT FOR TAT P27](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0027), [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P50](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0050)_

> Furious at Lionel Fairlie's insults, [Grace](../character/grace.md) marches back into his house and angrily confronts him. Amused and impressed by her spirit, Lionel warms to her, agrees to attend church once a month, and restores his financial contribution to her father's salary before driving her home with gifts.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT

TIT FOR TAT P59](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0059), [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P80](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0080)_

> [Mary Stubbs](../character/mary-stubbs.md) joins [Grace](../character/grace.md), [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md), [Bess](../character/bess-carrow.md), and [Izzy](../character/izzy.md) in [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow) to chew spruce gum. [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md) feels envious of Mary's fine new clothes and muff, while Mary brings news of local gossip and mentions that [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md) killed a rooster for dinner. Horrified that their pet rooster [Adam](../character/adam.md) has been killed, [Grace](../character/grace.md) rushes home, prompting [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md) to repentantly give Mary her gum and compliment her muff.
>
